counting_unit: declared provider/program/catalog configurations, not semantic equivalence classes
scope: captured native field/identity model; not engine RSS or scanner deployment

capture_dimensions.raw_input_policy: private native words and signature data; only counts and hashes may be published

reader_source_complexity.scope: lexical maintenance-complexity indicators; not cyclomatic complexity or an asymptotic proof

complexity.scope: component-wise scalar-GET semantic bounds, not CPU timing or whole-scanner complexity
complexity.identity_growth: O(log N) in identity object count
complexity.field_query_growth: O(D + 8), where D is the validated field dependency bound
limits: A descriptor visit is reported separately, not assumed to cost zero or one hardware load.
Packed loads are aligned u64 reads; the rank base is one u32 read.
Bounds include identity resolution when requested; binary-address lookup worsens O(1) direct field access.
Data-control tests exclude descriptor-static format dispatch, which is charged by descriptor visits.
No cache misses, compiler effects, syscall latency, wall time or RSS prediction is inferred.
The binary resolver is a declared design bound, not an instrumented scanner implementation.

qualification.scanner_correctness: not established by captured field replay

count_baseline.solver: Minisat22 enumeration, not linked counting algorithm

formula.counting_unit: complete assignment of declared primary Boolean variables

optimizer_process_observation.scope: this offline Python/native-solver process, including capture pages and construction; not scanner RAM

limitations: Only candidate field programs have current capture-derived serializers and nonoverlapping costs; other catalog choices remain explicit gated research variables.
The preserved baseline is this capture of the retained branch, distinct from original upstream performance qualification.
Query units charge declared resource primitives and lookup bounds, not instructions, cache behavior or CPU latency.
Growth regression is blocked by default; explicit logarithmic-lookup relaxation produces unqualified research proposals.
Known live extents and one worker tracking subset are accounted; other scanner, allocator and construction scratch memory is unknown, not zero.
Conversion/reload curves assume captured equal-size generations; all-changed updates and real RSS need measurements.
The MaxSAT optimum is within the generated candidate family; no independent UNSAT optimality certificate is exported.
Full-equivalence helper variables preserve configuration counts; different program descriptions can still implement equivalent semantics.
